item.title: Interstate 78 Closed in Both Directions After Multi-Vehicle Pile Up in Berks County
item.description: Interstate 78 is closed in both directions in Berks County following a multi-vehicle crash Saturday morning, according to Pennsylvania State Police. State police report that a 12-vehicle crash occurred on Interstate 78 at mile marker 39.1 in Greenwich Township near Lenhartsville. The crash involved four commercial vehicles and eight passenger vehicles. Emergency crews were dispatched to the scene at 7:51 a.m. and are currently assisting with vehicle extrication efforts.
